content.value: `bp-graph.js` — a self-contained Canvas2D renderer (Cytoscape gutted) that draws the Content Graph in Obsidian's visual idiom.
, the client half of the Graph View. It started on Cytoscape and was deliberately
down to a dependency-free Canvas2D renderer — no graph library, just
draw calls. That keeps the bundle small and gives full control over the visual language.

The look is tuned to match Obsidian: small monochrome dots for nodes, faint thin links, hover/selection emphasis. A Phantom Node is drawn dashed and muted to signal it is a Dangling Reference target that the Content Edges Table could never store. An Orphan Node sits alone with no links. The renderer hosts the Force Simulation — a hand-rolled velocity-Verlet layout — and steps it each animation frame, reading the
payload the Graph View pane ships from the server. No server round-trips during layout.

Every visual and physics parameter is chosen against the Graph Comparison fixture: the point is for Barkpark's graph to feel like Obsidian's so the two can be judged side by side. This vault is that fixture.
